purpose: Teach: 身勝手/行き届い/正気/脱帽/つまっ/のぞく/使いこなす/築き上げ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、身勝手にならず、お友達も大事にしようね
lines.en: Sho — don't be selfish. Your friends matter too.
lines.style: Gentle but direct. Warm firmness in the opening address. Leans forward slightly. The tone of someone who cares enough to say what needs saying without judgment. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんの気配りが家族全員に行き届いてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad's kindness really reaches everyone in our family.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. Small, genuine smile in the voice. Speaking more to himself than to her — observing something he's noticed and is trying to put into words. Soft, thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが疲れても正気を保ってお仕事されてるわ
lines.en: Sho — even when your dad is tired, he keeps his mind steady for work.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. Warm recognition in the tone. Speaking slowly, as if noticing something she respects. No rush — this is an acknowledgment that needs space to land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの工夫に脱帽だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I'm really impressed by how Dad figures things out.
lines.style: Bright earnestness. The energy of a child who's seen something and wants to tell her about it. Quick pace but not rushed. Genuine delight, no performance — just honest admiration.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、宿題が頭の中でつまってる時は休もうね
lines.en: Sho — when homework gets stuck in your head, take a break.
lines.style: Gentle guidance. Soft opening on his name. The cadence of someone older offering care without making it heavy. Warm but practical. A small pause before the instruction, like giving him space to listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの書斎をそっとのぞくのが好き
lines.en: Mei-sis — I like quietly peeking into Dad's study.
lines.style: Soft, almost shy. The voice of someone sharing something small and precious. Slow, delicate pace. Breathless slightly on 'quietly' — protecting the quiet of the moment. Wistful trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新しいツールを使いこなすまで応援しましょうね
lines.en: Sho — let's cheer Dad on while he learns to use his new tools.
lines.style: Warm encouragement. Inclusive 'let's' — drawing him in as a partner in this. Gentle but steady. The tone of someone who knows what support looks like and is inviting him to give it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと信頼を築き上げてきたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I've built real trust with Dad over time.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Speaking from something solid inside him. Slow, deliberate pace — each word has weight. Peaceful, almost grateful. No doubt in the voice, just steady certainty. Soft close.
